items.title: Johnny St. Cyr Interview, 1958-08-27
items.q: So we had rehearsal on St. Paul and Louis liked to do the bell off the horn.

ctx.x: St. Paul. And didn't it say good?

Yes. We had rehearsal. So we had rehearsal on St. Paul and Louis liked to do the bell off the horn. And we were playing one number. I don't remember what it was. I should have remembered it. But we were playing one number there and Louis got the plane, he come to an abrupt stop. So face it, what's the matter Louis? He said, man I had to stop and let some of them notes get out of this horn. He was making so many of them. He was hung up in the horn, he couldn't stop and let them get out.
